citation.title: In Vitro Simulation of Dental Implant Bridges Removal: Influence of Luting Agent and Abutments Geometry on Retrievability
citation.authors: Lugas AT, Terzini M, Zanetti EM, Schierano G, Manzella C, Baldi D, Bignardi C, Audenino AL

s_design.anchor: in-vitro bench study with a non-standard (custom impulsive-removal) protocol described in its essentials: factors, loading, outcome indexes, specimen count and statistics (MATERIAL row, 65)
s_design.evidence_quote: Impulsive forces were applied to dental bridge models to simulate crowns' retrievability in clinical conditions.

domains.evidence_quote: In this study, the retrievability of implant-fixed dental prostheses was investigated considering two of the main factors dental practitioners have to deal with: the abutments geometry and the luting agent.

domains.note: abstract gives the number of tests and combinations but no sample size calculation or stated reason for the count; the count itself does not address the domain (3b-ii)
abstract does not describe how specimens or tests were assigned to bridge/cement combinations
no mention of operator or assessor blinding in the abstract

domains.evidence_quote: a Kruskal-Wallis test was performed on the results

domains.note: abstract carries no funding or conflict-of-interest statement, as is conventional

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement / manufacturer funding
penalties.note: not assessable in abstract

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered
penalties.note: not applicable: in-vitro study, not an RCT

penalties.item: specimen count per group <10 with no justification (in-vitro)
penalties.evidence_quote: One-hundred-and-five tests were conducted on 21 combinations of bridges and luting agents
penalties.note: not assessable in abstract: about 5 tests per combination are reported, but whether a justification exists cannot be read from the abstract

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome requires
penalties.note: not applicable: bench retrievability test, no survival or longitudinal claim

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۳۶ و در باند D (شواهد ضعیف) برای سؤال از نوع MATERIAL است و چون فقط abstract در دسترس بود، نتیجه مقدماتی است.
sources.interpretation_fa: این یک مطالعه‌ی in-vitro است و abstract درباره‌ی توجیه تعداد نمونه، تخصیص نمونه‌ها، blinding و تضاد منافع چیزی نمی‌گوید. یافته‌ی اصلی اثر هندسه‌ی اباتمنت بر تعداد ضربه‌ی لازم برای برداشتن بریج است و نیرو رابطه‌ی روشنی با retrievability نداشت. ارزش آن در حد جهت‌دهی برای ترجیح اباتمنت بلند با taper کم و سمان موقت است، نه شاهد بالینی.
